final: WITH per_source AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / s.boxx) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference, AVG(s.aream2 / s.volm3) AS area_to_volume FROM projects AS p JOIN scanspatial AS s ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), threshold AS (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume) AS cross_source_average FROM per_source) SELECT per_source.fundflux, per_source.avg_y_vs_x_difference, per_source.area_to_volume, per_source.area_to_volume - threshold.cross_source_average AS above_cross_source_average FROM per_source CROSS JOIN threshold WHERE per_source.area_to_volume > threshold.cross_source_average
